scope: Forbidden Forge paid ritual transitive definition source audit
verified: Ritual.DIRECT_CODEC contains main_ingredient, inputs[].ingredient, result, essences/tier/enhancers, magic_circle holder ID and duration; referenced item-tag members/enhancer values are not recursively encoded.
Ingredient is final; NeoForge public isCustom/getValues expose exact vanilla ItemValue/TagValue. getItems caches resolved ItemStack[]; never use as current tag snapshot.

Ingredient.TagValue resolves BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getTagOrEmpty at first cache build; absent/empty tag synthesizes BARRIER. Current fingerprint must read actual registry tag members, not synthetic fallback.

HolderSet.Named survives tag reload. bind replaces private contents with List.copyOf and calls invalidation listeners. List.copyOf may return same immutable List; Named identity alone never proves unchanged membership.
MappedRegistry.bindTags uses existing Named objects via computeIfAbsent; resetTags binds empty lists. Current registry.getTag(key) and membership iteration is correct bounded no-cache strategy.

RitualRequirements.enhancers is HolderSet<EnhancerDefinition>; named set must be resolved via current enhancer registry and expanded. Direct holder references must be checked against current registry object values.
Installed physical enhancer ItemStack component points ResourceKey resolved through current holder lookup. Full EnhancerDefinition.CODEC contains description, display_item and effects.

Known native effect classes carry only scalar numbers and EssenceType enum; known TimeCondition carries only int start/end. Unknown addon effect/condition classes cannot be approved solely by successful serialization.
MagicCircleType contains only inner_texture and outer_texture ResourceLocations. Its transitive texture changes are visual and intentionally excluded from gameplay dependency snapshot.
Existing direct ritual hash may still include magic-circle holder ID; keep unchanged for schema1 receipt compatibility.

defaults.note: Generated source defaults, not proof of current runtime registry after datapacks/KubeJS; installed enhancers create dependencies even when recipe requires none.

implementation_recommendation.cache: Initially no tag-membership cache; bounded current registry membership each validation. Do not add registry invalidation listener retaining a manager/server strongly.
implementation_recommendation.unsupported: Fail closed on custom Ingredient, unknown Ingredient.Value or unknown enhancer effect/condition; preserve paid state and allow explicit backed-up operator cancel.
implementation_recommendation.migration: Old paid receipt without dependency fingerprint may continue only if current supported definition has no item-tag/required or installed enhancer dependencies. Never infer historical dependency snapshot from current datapack.
implementation_recommendation.bounds: Bound input/value/tag/member/effect/condition expansion and encoded bytes before SHA; budget must reject before unbounded collect/codec work. Native main+8inputs and4installed slots bound structural fanout but external tags may be arbitrarily large.
implementation_recommendation.fullpack: Optional weaving, actual datapack reload, survival progression and TPS profiling still need exact installed modpack.
